_comment: Owner-visible decisions for branches whose commits are not (all) reachable from the authoritative branch. tools/branch_ledger.py --check fails for any other unmerged branch.

origin/main.disposition: Its one extra commit (41f5f5a) uploads Hot_Attic_Games_Master_Logo_ALPHA_FINAL.png at the repo root. The authoritative branch carries the byte-identical file (blob e11f8c5) at launch/branding/, which is the path the game uses (CLAUDE.md). main itself is 78+ commits behind and has never received v11-v18: merging the authoritative branch into main is an OWNER decision (protected branch).

origin/windows-internal-test.disposition: Orphan branch (no common history) that only holds desktop build archives and a README, because release assets cannot be uploaded from the development environment. It carries no product code. Do not develop on it. Replace with release assets or CI artifacts when available; keep until the owner agrees (binary history is large).

_content_findings.note: CLAUDE.md: the original logo file name is obsolete; the only canonical artwork is Hot_Attic_Games_Master_Logo_ALPHA_FINAL.png (present at launch/branding/).
CLAUDE.md: there is one product, no separate 'Legacy' game; the legacy icon set was dropped.
